queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink,
         o.dealedge AS dealedge,
         AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS group_avg_net_rate,
         COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009
  GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.dealedge
),
s AS (
  SELECT dealedge,
         AVG(group_avg_net_rate) AS side_avg_net_rate
  FROM g
  WHERE group_avg_net_rate IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY dealedge
)
SELECT g.orderslink,
       g.dealedge,
       g.group_avg_net_rate,
       g.record_count,
       s.side_avg_net_rate,
       g.group_avg_net_rate - s.side_avg_net_rate AS diff_from_side_avg
FROM g
LEFT JOIN s ON g.dealedge = s.dealedge
ORDER BY diff_from_side_avg DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
SELECT feerange, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate, COUNT(feerate - rebrate) AS record_count FROM fees GROUP BY feerange
SELECT AVG(feerate - COALESCE(rebrate, 0)) FROM fees
SELECT feerange, COUNT(*) AS fee_count, AVG(feerate) AS avg_feerate, AVG(rebrate) AS avg_rebrate
FROM fees
WHERE feerate IS NOT NULL AND rebrate IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY feerange;
SELECT dealedge, AVG(COALESCE(group_avg, 0)) AS side_avg
FROM (
  SELECT dealedge, mktnote, AVG(notionsum) AS group_avg
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY dealedge, mktnote
)
GROUP BY dealedge;
SELECT o.dealedge, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_rate
FROM fees f
JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
GROUP BY o.dealedge;
